mapper.select: SELECT n.*, u.real_name AS author_name, c.course_name, m.major_name, t.real_name AS recommend_teacher_name FROM study_note n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_course c ON n.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_major m ON n.major_id = m.id LEFT JOIN sys_user t ON n.recommend_teacher_id = t.id WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.deleted = 0
